changeSet.author: Axelix Team
changeSet.comment: Drops the legacy users.roles JSON column. Its content was copied into users_roles by 1.1-010, and since 1.1 nothing reads or writes it anymore. Native ALTER TABLE DROP COLUMN is used instead of dropColumn, because the latter makes Liquibase rebuild the whole table on SQLite, which users_roles references (see 1.1-011).
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE users DROP COLUMN roles;
